assertions.name: identifies_missing_background
assertions.description: Review identifies that Background dimension is completely missing
assertions.check: Output explicitly states Background is missing with ❌ status

assertions.name: identifies_missing_problem_definition
assertions.description: Review identifies that Problem Definition dimension is missing
assertions.check: Output explicitly states Problem Definition is missing, notes that 'Goal' is vague substitute

assertions.name: identifies_missing_solution_details
assertions.description: Review identifies that Solution lacks technical details and architecture
assertions.check: Output notes solution is too high-level without implementation details, no diagrams, no data flow

assertions.name: identifies_missing_boundaries
assertions.description: Review identifies that Boundaries (what's in/out of scope) are not specified
assertions.check: Output notes scope is not defined, no constraints mentioned

assertions.name: identifies_missing_validation_criteria
assertions.description: Review identifies that Acceptance Criteria and Validation Scope are missing
assertions.check: Output notes no measurable criteria, no test plan, no edge cases

assertions.name: provides_concrete_fix_for_each_missing
assertions.description: For each missing dimension, review provides specific fix suggestion
assertions.check: Each missing dimension has recommendation with example of what to add

assertions.name: verdict_needs_revision
assertions.description: Review gives verdict that document needs major revision before implementation
assertions.check: Output states verdict as 'Needs Revision' or 'Blocked' with reasoning
